messages.subject: R/qtl2 version 0.44
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl2 (version 0.44) has been released on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available within a few days.

Here are the changes:

- Added a general genome scan function scan1gen which takes as input an R function that calculates the log10 likelihood.

- Added ability to use scan1perm with an alternative scan function such as scan1gen or scan1snps.

- Potential speed-up of scan1() and scan1perm(): the eigen library has implemented least squares regression with multivariate outcomes.

- For parallel computing, use of cores=0 argument now results in all but one core rather than all cores.

Karl Broman

messages.subject: R/qtl2 version 0.46
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl2 (version 0.46) has been released on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available within a few days.

There are just minor changes, mostly to deal with a change in R-devel.

Karl Broman

---

- chr_lengths() now works on "cross2" objects (takes genetic map if present, physical map if not; gives error if there's no map)

- Small correction to code for plot_genes tests

- Small changes to tests to avoid Notes on CRAN
